subject: general
question: What should be done if oil or grease is found on the clutch lining?
solution:
The correct answer is __Replace new lining**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Oil or grease on the clutch lining can lead to loss of friction, causing the clutch to slip.
 
• Replacing the lining ensures optimal performance and prevents further damage to the clutch system.
 
• Cleaning with petrol (Option 3) is not recommended as it does not effectively restore the lining.
 
• Tightening the pressure spring (Option 2) will not address the root cause of the problem.
 
• Applying more grease (Option 4) is counterproductive and worsens the issue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Clutch Lining:**

 
 
• The clutch lining is a frictional material that enables the clutch to engage and disengage the transmission effectively.
 
• It is essential for smooth power transmission from the engine to the wheels.
 
 
 
• **Common Issues:**
 
 
• Oil or grease contamination can occur due to leaks in the transmission or engine system.
 
• Timely inspection and maintenance prevent costly repairs and ensure safety.
